compos.text: A green parrot is standing on a kitchen counter next to a blender. The parrot is holding a toothbrush in its beak. The background features a window with a view of greenery and a pink tiled wall. There is a red square button with a white border in the top left corner of the screen.
Alt text: "Back button icon, represented by a left-pointing triangle."

The bottom of the screen shows standard navigation buttons for a smartphone, including a triangle (back), circle (home), and square (recent apps).
